description.value: Zinc Bar is a historic bar and jazz club in Greenwich Village. It occupies the famous space at 82 W 3rd street once known as the Cinderella Club where Billie Holiday performed. Posted hours run late, with Friday 5 pm - 2 am, so it suits a late night.
